analysis: The code snippet is a method that iterates over units using an iterator. Before calling `next()`, it checks `hasNext()` in the while loop condition. This ensures that `next()` is only called when there is at least one more element. The only documented exception for `next()` is `NoSuchElementException`, which is thrown when there are no more elements. Since the `hasNext()` check prevents calling `next()` on an exhausted iterator, the `NoSuchElementException` condition is avoided.
remark: The loop condition `while (unitsIt.hasNext())` guarantees that `next()` is only invoked when the iterator has more elements, thus preventing `NoSuchElementException`.
